Flow.description: [Arkus/BL 4-21-25] Runs on Create or Update of a Gift Transaction when one of the following is changed: Original Amount, Transaction Due Date, Transaction Conditional?, and Condition Met?. The flow updates the Receivable Cateogry picklist field on Gift Transaction based on the "Receivable Cateogry (Formula)" logic on Gift Transaction. v2 - [Arkus/BL 6-17-25] added entry criteria to the flow so it runs if status on Gift Transaction is changed.

formulas.description: Holds the same formula logic as the "Receivable Category (Formula)" field on Gift Transaction.
